records.verbatim: Microsoft today announced a $10 billion (approx. ¥1.6 trillion) investment in Japan from 2026 through 2029, built around three pillars: Technology, Trust, and Talent. The commitments include expanding our own in-country infrastructure
records.notes: First-party: Brad Smith, Microsoft Vice Chair & President, Microsoft Source Asia, 3 Apr 2026. Investment figure is company-stated, not a site figure. Japanese-language version of the release not fetched.

records.verbatim: Microsoft is announcing a new collaboration with Sakura Internet and SoftBank to meet exactly that need. Through this collaboration, domestic providers will offer GPU-based AI compute services through Azure, while data residency remains in Japan.
records.notes: First-party, same release. Two sentences joined by a single space in the record; the second quoted sentence is the operative claim. Not a site-specific project; no Project record implied. Japan-hosted compute (data residency), not a siting commitment.

records.verbatim: El Segundo Tribunal Ambiental de Santiago determinó anular parcialmente la aprobación del proyecto "Cerrillos Data Center" de Google, para que incluya efectos del cambio climático. Por ello, ordenó al Servicio de Evaluación Ambiental (SEA) retrotraer el procedimiento de evaluación de la iniciativa, para que se incorpore dicha condición en la evaluación del componente hídrico.
records.translation: The Second Environmental Court of Santiago ruled to partially annul the approval of Google's "Cerrillos Data Center" project, so that it includes the effects of climate change. It therefore ordered the Environmental Assessment Service (SEA) to roll back the evaluation procedure so that this condition is incorporated into the assessment of the water component. (machine translation, AI)
records.notes: Court ruling as reported by BioBioChile 27 Feb 2024; this is a third-party report of a court decision, so it is a CommunityResponse-type record (constituency regulator), not a Google claim. Not yet re-checked against the tribunal's own sentencia PDF. Later status unknown: the 2026 search found no reevaluation outcome. Prior project (Google renounced the original project Sept 2024 per Meganoticias) should be checked before attaching to a project_id.

leads.notes: Search found no 2026 Japanese notice setting PUE 1.3. Only the 2022 benchmark revision (target PUE 1.4). The 1.3 threshold in search results is from EU EED 2023/1791 and Germany's EnEfG, not Japan. Keep the existing held lead and do not cite 1.3 for Japan.
